text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Phew~~! That should fix the rattling on 
the offertory box. ...How's it going over 
there?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Going great! We've weeded most of that 
area over there~! At this rate, we'll have 
it all cleaned up before New Year's Eve!

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Hoho~, with five Umamusume helping out, it 
goes by in no time at all. Alright, I 
better do my best too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, let's do our best. But please take 
care of yourself, okay? We'll handle the 
heavy lifting. ...By the way, where is 
Sweep-san?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Look, everyone! I found 
something totally amazing in the storage 
shed!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
This is ab-so-lutely a magic item!! I can 
feel its powerful magic...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eh, is it really? Looks like an old tray 
or maybe a shield to me...? Ah! No! It's a 
magic item! It must be!

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho, that's an "ancient mirror." How 
nostalgic. So that's where it was.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
An ancient mirror... It's a mirror? But it 
doesn't reflect clearly at all! It's just 
super blurry...

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's from ancient times. It was used 
in a New Year's ritual we used to hold 
long ago. It's a sacred artifact.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A ritual... Now that you mention it, you 
said something about that when we first 
met too—

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
People from around the neighborhood used 
to come for Hatsumode, and the ritual was 
quite lively back then, but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, by that ritual, could you perhaps mean 
the "Uma Maiden Pilgrimage"?

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you know of it? That's the one. The 
Uma Maiden Pilgrimage was an annual New 
Year's event—it used to be quite a 
spectacle~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I once read about it in a local history 
book. If I recall, it's a unique shrine 
ritual passed down to divine the fortunes 
of the coming year, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Divination? Wow, that makes it sound even 
more magical! Hey, hey, what do you do 
during the ritual?

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text: Hohoho, let's see now—

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
At the crack of dawn on New Year's Day, 
before it gets light out, two Umamusume 
shrine maidens would climb the mountain 
behind the shrine carrying the ancient 
mirror and a light...

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
The maidens would light the bonfires along 
the mountain path as they made their way 
up, aiming to reach the summit before the 
first sunrise... And then...

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
The moment the sun rose, they would catch 
the first rays of dawn on the summit with 
the ancient mirror. When the people on the 
shrine grounds saw the flash from the 
peak, everyone would light return signal 
fires.

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
—It had to catch the very first light of 
dawn, so some years they wouldn't make it 
in time. But if it went well, it was said 
the worshippers would enjoy good health 
and ward off illness all year long.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, how fascinating. There are many 
other detailed traditions about it as 
well... like how it won't succeed the year 
after a mild winter, or how the zodiac 
animal affects it...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well, deciding that it won't succeed over 
things like that is simply unacceptable! 
Jinxes like that are meant to be broken...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but it's an event from the past, isn't 
it? Mmm, I got so caught up in the idea of 
taking on the challenge...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Then just do it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean, just do it...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm talking to you. Why don't you do 
something that sounds so fun nowadays?

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Hrm, there are all sorts of reasons~. 
There are plenty of customs that just 
don't fit with the modern era~.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What's that supposed to mean? Doesn't fit 
with the modern era? If there's something 
wrong with it, just change it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah... I get what Sweep-san is 
saying. I'm really curious about that 
tradition too...!

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho, it gladdens me to see you young 
folks so interested. I see... "change" it, 
huh? Would that really be alright to do?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's definitely alright! Most traditional 
events are updated to match the times, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's true...! I agree too! Why don't we 
bring back the Uma Maiden Pilgrimage in a 
new form?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If we revive it in a great way, it'll 
surely liven up the shrine even more...! 
It's about time for our lunch break 
anyway, so please tell us all the details!

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
—*Slurp*... Phew...! ...And that's the 
kind of customs it had.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see...! Hrmmm... "The maidens must fast 
starting three days prior," huh...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fasting is way too harsh~! Ugh... people 
in the past sure had a ton of grit...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Climbing a mountain path in traditional 
shrine maiden attire... wearing nothing 
but "straw sandals" also feels rather 
dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Right? You wouldn't want to make people do 
that sort of thing nowadays, would you? 
Especially since health comes first for 
Umamusume who run in races.

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then... let's drop both of them. 
Not doing that sort of thing won't change 
our spirit of celebrating the New Year, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, that was decided fast~♪ Oh, I 
know! 
For the fasting, let's make it so "shrine 
maidens get all-you-can-eat chocolate 3 
days prior"!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-chan~, let's not forget this is a 
sacred ritual, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... I hate to interrupt our flow, 
but 
shouldn't we first clarify the "essential 
points" that must not be changed?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The essential points that mustn't be 
changed...?
